# Brandon Allan Fluegel, Ph.D. — Human Factors Engineer

Canonical: https://humanfactors.pro/
Primary identity: Brandon Allan Fluegel, Ph.D.
Role focus: Human Factors Engineer
Specialties: Human Factors, Human Factors Engineering, Human-AI Interaction, Psychophysics, Neuroimaging, Product Strategy

Summary:
Brandon Allan Fluegel is a Human Factors Engineer and PhD with research impact at Amazon, Uber, NASA, and Mercedes-Benz. He specializes in Human-AI Interaction, psychophysics, cognitive load assessment, neuroimaging (fNIRS), and translating human perception research into monetizable product strategy.

Case Studies:

Amazon (Devices Design Group) — Human Factors & Business Strategy:
Brandon Allan Fluegel led a multi-year human factors research program calibrating Alexa voice response latency to human perceptual thresholds. Using a custom Wizard of Oz latency engine across 20,000+ controlled interactions, he identified the 900ms "High Satisfaction Threshold." Integrating findings into the Negative Value Action (NVA) model projected $50M+ in incremental revenue over 15 months. Also conducted neuroimaging (fNIRS) to benchmark FireTV UI cognitive load against Apple TV and Netflix, and led Human Factors strategy for the Echo Show portfolio (75M+ customers). 2023 Amazon Inventor Award recipient.

Uber — Human Factors Research:
Research-led product improvements addressing cognitive load and retention across the Uber driver and rider experience.

NASA — Human Factors:
Mission-critical human factors validation for high-stakes system performance and operator safety in aerospace environments.

Mercedes-Benz — HMI Human Factors Research:
Human-machine interface (HMI) research improving driver trust, cognitive ergonomics, and system transparency in advanced automotive AI systems.
